title: First Evidence of Cotton at Neolithic Mehrgarh, Pakistan
version: Harappa.com (summary and extracts of the 2002 Journal of Archaeological Science article)

passages.locator: Second paragraph of the page's summary of Moulherat et al. 2002
passages.quote: several threads preserved by mineralization in a copper bead from a Neolithic burial (6th millennium) at Mehrgarh, Pakistan, were subject to rigorous metallurgical analysis. Under this new microscopic procedure, the fibres were identiﬁed as cotton (genus Gossypium ).
